Title: The Ancient and Modern History of the Brethren, or, a Succinct Narrative of the Protestant Church of the United Brethren, or Unitas Fratrum, in the remoter Ages, and particularly in the present Century; written in German by David Cranz, now translated into English, with Emendations, and published with some additional Notes by Benjamin La Trobe
Creator: David Cranz (1723-1777); translated by 'some kind hands' (preface) and edited with notes by Benjamin La Trobe (1728-1786)
Publisher: London: printed by W. and A. Strahan, and sold by J. Robson, T. Cadell, C. Dilly, and at the settlements and chapels of the congregations of the Brethren
Publication Date: 1780
Rights: Public Domain (published 1780, more than 95 years ago; public domain by date under the project's rolling rule; the item carries no rights field, so the date rule alone applies)
Source: Internet Archive item ancientmodernhis00cran (https://archive.org/details/ancientmodernhis00cran), the item's own ancientmodernhis00cran_djvu.txt full-text OCR derivative; contributing library per the item metadata: State Library of Pennsylvania; host metadata date: 1780. Fetched directly (curl/urllib, raw bytes) by the Library thread (Era VIII pass), 2026-10-23. sha256 of the raw fetched bytes: 3adccf69470346618810c653a9a757e3a8324c9d7fb41a7a8706c1bc55e69cff.
Provenance note: Header prepended by the Library thread; nothing else altered, no OCR error corrected, nothing retyped. State Library of Pennsylvania scan; readable with the long s kept; the Internet Archive's own digitisation notice precedes the title page and is left in place.
Content note: Cranz's official history of the Unity (Alte und neue Brüder-Historie, 1771) in English: the old Czech Unity in its first part, then Herrnhut from 1722 year by year in numbered paragraphs, including the Brotherly Agreement of 1727, the renewal, the settlements and the missions; the church's own narrative of its own century.
